Top pain points you shared:
- High latency on current LLM endpoints during peak hours (~800-1,200ms per request)
- Variable cost per token impacting predictability for batch processing use cases
- Lack of versioning/rollout controls when pushing model updates

Primary POC goals:
1) Demonstrate 2x reduction in median inference latency for the targeted workflow (current median ~850ms)
2) Show predictable unit economics for batch inference at expected scale (50k requests/day)
3) Validate Redwood routing + caching preserves quality on your 40-item prompt set (target ROUGE/accuracy baseline TBD)

Proposed POC scope (high-level):
- Duration: 6 weeks
- Workloads: customer support reranking + short-form generation (~avg 120 tokens)
- Metrics: median latency, p95 latency, tokens/sec cost, model output quality on provided eval set
- Owners: Aditya (account), Marissa (program manager), Rishi (SE)

1) I attached a mutual_action_plan.xlsx with owners and dates. Please review and confirm. [Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx]

4) Technical kickoff meeting: propose Wed 12/2 10:00am PT — please confirm availability.

Let me know if I missed anything. Looking forward to getting started.

Thanks Sarah — opening a few items and adding details on the POC execution plan. Please see the scope doc attached (redwood_poc_scope.pdf).

POC Execution (detailed):
- Week 0 (Prep, Days 0-3): Access & onboarding
  - Redwood creates a customer sandbox project; we need: S3 read-only creds (scoped), list of IPs for allowlist, and an admin user for the Redwood console.
  - Deliverable: onboarding checklist + invite to project workspace

- Week 1-2 (Baseline & Integration):
  - Ingest sample prompts, run baseline inference against your current endpoints (you provide a curl script or recorded requests)
  - Deliverable: baseline latency/cost report + initial prompt set mapping

- Week 3-4 (Optimization & Eval):
  - Apply batching/caching profiles, try quantized model variant; run evaluation suite on your provided expected_output set
  - Deliverable: evaluation report (median/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, quality regression matrix)

- Week 5-6 (Wrap & Handoff):
  - Run final comparison, produce runbook for production rollout and recommended model/config settings
  - Deliverable: final report + canary rollout plan

Metrics and evals:
- Primary: median latency (target <400ms), p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens at target throughput, quality vs baseline (acceptable delta defined by you)
- We will use the prompt/eval template attached in the Drive link below to report scores and regressions.

Quick technical notes ahead of the kickoff: 

- For the sample data, read-only S3 with a folder named /acme-poc/samples is ideal. I only need an ARN and a short-lived key pair for ingestion. Minimum IAM: s3:GetObject on that prefix.
- Model & quantization: for short-form generation at ~120 tokens we recommend trying the gpt-like-open-13B q4_0 variant first for a balance of latency and quality; we can do a quick comparison to your current model endpoints during baseline runs.
- Prompt set: include at least 40-50 prompts per intent if you can (helps stability of quality signals).

I’ll bring a prebuilt eval harness to the kickoff so we can demo a baseline run in ~30 minutes. Looking forward to Wed 12/2 10:00am PT.
